name: RealIR-Bench
description:
RealIR-Bench
	

Arrow-based upload package aligned with the GEdit-Bench style.

Images are embedded directly inside the dataset shards.
The dataset split is stored as test.
No external image path resolution is required for the viewer.
general_score_metric: PSNR (primary); SSIM and LPIPS commonly reported
reputation: A niche dataset used within the real-world image restoration community; moderate adoption among restoration researchers.
